scripts.build: pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared test && pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared lint && pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared format && pnpm --filter backend format && pnpm --filter frontend format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared format:check && pnpm --filter backend format:check && pnpm --filter frontend format:check
scripts.allcheck: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
